events.evidence: A toxic gas attack, allegedly by Syrian warplanes, kills at least 83 and injures many more in rebel-held Khan Shaykhun, Idlib
The United Nations announces expansion of civilian camps for people fleeing Mosul, following resumption of airstrikes on ISIL-held portions of the Iraqi city
The National Assembly of Hungary passes a bill that undermines the functioning of the Central European University (CEU)

label.note: Syria chemical attack is main new risk; Mosul and Hungary academic crackdown add secondary concerns.
